source.input_method: latest row per ID ordered by version DESC then added_at DESC; existing deterministic hash(id)%1000=0 ID sample
source.non_rt_rule: exclude rows whose body starts with exact 'RT @'
source.author_selection: one hash(id)-selected non-RT post per author/day/lang, then cap by hash(author_id)

model.description: XLM-R base continued pretraining on Twitter and fine-tuned for 3-way sentiment.
model.pretraining_corpus: approximately 198M tweets; XLM-T language-model pretraining covers 30+ languages
limitations: The sentiment head was fine-tuned on UMSAB benchmark data in eight languages, not this corpus.
The card says it can be used for more languages, but unsupported-language predictions are not covered by the eight-language benchmark claim.
Scores are text-level polarity and must not be interpreted as sentiment toward a discovered topic without target-aware validation.
Twitter slang, code-switching, sarcasm, quoted text, and retweet templates can produce uncertain or mis-targeted predictions.
Softmax probabilities are model confidence scores, not calibrated probabilities; compare strata with uncertainty intervals.

preprocessing.normalization: Collapse whitespace; replace tokens beginning with @ (length > 1) by @user and tokens beginning with http by http, following the model card.
preprocessing.deduplicate_key: exact raw body string before normalization; one prediction mapped back to every matching ID

analysis_guidance.topic_targeting: Do not call this output topic-targeted sentiment; aggregate only after topic assignment and inspect target relevance.
analysis_guidance.recommended_shift_estimator: For each topic/day, report mean sentiment_score and bootstrap or Wilson intervals on author-clustered samples; compare against daily language/RT composition baselines.
analysis_guidance.retweets_and_templates: Keep RT-prefixed rows separate or downweight them; collapse identical text for inference but retain ID-level prevalence and author counts so templates cannot masquerade as independent language evidence.
analysis_guidance.author_concentration: Use author-cluster bootstrap or effective sample size; report both tweet-weighted and author-weighted estimates.
analysis_guidance.unsupported_languages: Do not silently pool unsupported language codes with supported ones; report them separately or exclude with counts and sensitivity bounds.
